_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
"The container" is the messages container (".messages-container"), "the button" the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button"), and "the gap" the container's scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop. To "send" a message, fill the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) with it and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]). Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable. Perform the steps in order. The test seeds a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose first message is "echo message 0". To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input to be visible (allow 30s). To "add message N", send "echo message N" and wait until a [data-testid="message"] element containing the text "echo message N" is visible (allow 30s). A scroll-up racing list growth in the same frame is not overridden.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Add message 1; then add message 2; then add message 3; then add message 4.
3. The button must not be visible (allow 5s).
4. Scroll to the top and grow the list in the same task, so no observer callback can run in between, and deliberately with no wheel event (those handlers would hide the bug): in one eval, set the container's scrollTop to 0, then append to its ".messages-list" a div 800px tall with attribute data-test-filler="1".
5. The reader must stay where they scrolled to: wait until the container's scrollTop is below 50 (allow 3s). The button should be visible (allow 5s).

steps.expression: const c = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); c.scrollTop = 0; const d = document.createElement('div'); d.style.height = '800px'; d.setAttribute('data-test-filler', '1'); document.querySelector('.messages-container .messages-list').appendChild(d);
